title: Boundary $h^\ast$-vectors and unimodular triangulations
summary: We study the Ehrhart $h^\ast$-polynomial of (the boundary of) a lattice polytope via regular unimodular triangulations and Gröbner degenerations of toric ideals. Our main result is a boundary analogue of the well-known Sturmfels correspondence. This allows us to connect the boundary $h^\ast$-polynomial to the $h$-polynomial of any regular unimodular triangulation, in analogy to the classical Betke-McMullen Theorem.
